narrative:
No non-compliant items were identified on this inspection. This site is determined to be in compliance.
All sites used for regulated activity must demonstrate full compliance with the Animal Welfare Act prior to issuance of a
license. The inspection and exit briefing were conducted with the applicant.
A copy of your license will be sent to you without any additional action on your part once all sites are determined to be in
compliance.
Conducting regulated activities without a valid USDA license is a violation of the Animal Welfare Act.
You may appeal any inspection report to the Deputy Administrator. You must submit your appeal of a licensing inspection
report within 7 days of receipt and all other inspection reports within 21 days of receipt.
